description: Address semantic review findings: add rate limiting, input validation, .dockerignore, Docker image optimization, fix K8s image path, and improve user-facing error message.
steps: 1. Add in-memory rate limiting to /api/ai-chat and /api/voice/tts endpoints (sliding window, per-IP, no new deps)
2. Add input length validation: cap message at 1000 chars, text at 2000 chars
4. Optimize Dockerfile to run npm ci --omit=dev in production stage for smaller image
5. Fix K8s deployment.yaml image path to use a template variable matching deploy workflow
6. Change no-API-key response to a user-friendly message instead of revealing configuration details
acceptance_criteria: Rate limiting is in place for AI/TTS endpoints (returns 429 on excess requests)
Input length validation rejects oversized messages with 400 status
Docker production image only includes production dependencies
K8s deployment.yaml image path uses a placeholder that matches deploy.yml pattern
No internal config details are exposed in user-facing AI responses
findings: All 6 review issues addressed. Rate limiting uses a sliding window Map (20 req/min/IP) with periodic cleanup. Input validation returns 400 for oversized messages. Docker image now uses 3 stages (builder, deps with --omit=dev, production). Production deps install went from full devDependencies to only 109 production packages. K8s image uses OWNER/REPO placeholder. The no-API-key message now says 'AI assistant is temporarily unavailable' instead of revealing config details. Lint, build, and docker build all pass.
